task: Expose exported object method signatures from canonical ABI-v10 records without relying on legacy semantic rows.
observation: The ABI-v10 nominal-template writer discarded the entire exported object template when one method had a non-no-op body, even when that method was a pure constant return whose callable signature and zero observable effects were straightforward to prove.
impact: A restricted zero-argument integer-literal return method now retains the nominal and method-template records. A consumer with the legacy object semantic row removed loads the v10 facts and type-checks the method call.

resolution.summary: The pure integer-literal method signature is serialized and consumed without its legacy semantic row; all eleven Java tests pass in staged ABI-v10 and ABI-v9. General method bodies, effects, generic methods, and native linkage remain incomplete.
